metrics.name: Total views
metrics.business_definition: Combined count of article.viewed, video.watched, and category.viewed events in the selected period.
caveats: Synthetic metric; not an upstream event type.

metrics.name: Article views
metrics.business_definition: Count of article.viewed events in the selected period.

metrics.name: Selected-period article-level views estimate
metrics.business_definition: Directional article-level selected-period estimate produced by scaling all-time article counts by the selected-period share of total daily article traffic.
metrics.source: CMS top-n article totals plus CMS daily article.viewed series
caveats: Not article-level exact for selected periods; use only for prioritization until article-day facts are available.

metrics.name: Average CSAT
metrics.business_definition: Average survey rating for valid CSAT responses in the selected scope.
metrics.source: CSAT upload or Domo CSAT dataset

metrics.name: Solved rate
metrics.business_definition: Share of CSAT survey responses where the survey solved flag is true.
metrics.source: CSAT upload or Domo CSAT dataset
caveats: This is not true first-call resolution.

metrics.name: True first-call resolution
metrics.business_definition: Share of opportunities with exactly one call in the selected scope. Requires opportunity IDs and call IDs.
metrics.source: CSAT upload or Domo CSAT dataset

metrics.name: Low rating rate
metrics.business_definition: Share of CSAT responses with rating 1 or 2.
metrics.source: CSAT upload or Domo CSAT dataset

metrics.name: Starter guide completion rate
metrics.business_definition: Share of starter-guide instances completed in the selected period or journey scope.
